While in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, your {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skill damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|x%|]{/c} for every point of {c_important}Dominance{/c} you currently have. 
While not in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, you gain {c_number}[{SF_2}]{/c} {c_important}Dominance{/c} every {c_number}[{SF_3}]{/c} seconds.
